page.layout: One page of text: a title block centred at the top with a printed ornament above it, then running text in one column with a large initial P. At the foot, a gathering signature.

main_text.head: Oratio habita in Schola The-ologica Oxon. à R.S. sacræ Theolo-giæ Regio PROFESSORE, cùm pub-licam professionem auspicaretur. 26. Oct. 1646.
main_text.p: Postquam mihi, integro jam quadriennio & quod excurrit, quicquid est hoc professorii sive muneris delegatum, sive oneris impositum esse sensi: dici vix potest (Auditores) quam horruerim totus; quàm varia adversantesque sibi cogitationes mox animum alternatim incesserint meum. Obversabantur imprimis ante oculos quamplurima, quæ virum longè viri-bus

page.notes: The large initial is a woodcut P, joined to "ostquam" as "Postquam". The long s is printed as f throughout, so "Oftquam" is read as "Postquam" and "fenfi" as "sensi". The title's hyphenated line-end breaks are kept as printed. The last line "bus" completes "viri-bus" from the line above. The title ornament above the heading is not transcribed. No page number or running head is printed.
